speaker: alse_pinder
text: The copper is on, sir. She has had it on since the bells.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Galls, copperas, and gum. The same receipt. You will have a black horn if you sit still and let it cool.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit. I am wanted at two, and I would rather carry ink than a pale horn.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twopence the horn, as it has always been. You may put the money on the stair-table when you come down. I am not coming up for it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence. I have it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the Holinshed again. I told him off. He went back. Master Field's cloth is under him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the cat. The book has survived him since March. A Monday is not the day I wage war on a cat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him stay. I am not opening that book today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. What you do open, you will not tell me over a boiling pot. I had the supper on Saturday. I do not need a plot with my copperas.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no plot for the kitchen. There is a letter in the play that never came. That is all I will say of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then that is all I will hear. A letter that never came is enough mystery for a Monday.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Will you eat before you go, sir? The board is threepence, and the beef is yesterday's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat. Threepence, and then the lane.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are cast, I suppose. You have the look of a man who must be painted.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in the Navarre comedy at two. I am not in whatever they have hung across the water.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then keep the title you are in, and leave the other on its nail. You will drink this when it is cool, and you will not spill it on Field's book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not spill it. The cat has the book. I have the horn.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Six years he has been dead, at this tide, and the receipt is still blacker than the scriveners. I said so on Saturday. I am not saying it twice for the pot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You said it. The horn is the remembering. I am not asking for more.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will set your trencher. She likes the horn cool before it is corked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will wait. I have an hour before I must be in the yard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then use it to eat. The play can have you at two. The house has you until you have paid the twopence and cleared the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence, and the board. I am not starting a quarrel with either.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib has put a paw on the cloth. I am leaving him. You can tell Master Field the volume is whole when he asks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He asks every month. Today he has not asked. The volume can keep the cat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then today the cat is librarian. Take your bread.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Bread, and a trencher. I will not pack you a dinner for the yard. The yard feeds its own.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The yard can feed me after. I am going up for the horn when she says it is cool, and then I am for Shoreditch.
